lines.text: The son is told to accept the words, call out to insight, and search for wisdom like hidden treasure.
The son will discover the knowledge of God, and the LORD gives wisdom and shields those with integrity.
Wisdom will enter the son's heart, and discretion and understanding will watch over him and guard him.
The son will be delivered from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of light.
The forbidden woman forgets the covenant of her father, and her house sinks down to death.
